The addition of keyword search (BM25) to LexiSearch was based on the performance of the hybrid retrieval method, which showed better results than the standalone BM25 approach. This was due to the fact that hybrid retrieval was clearly best, and the performance difference between BM25 and the hybrid retrieval method was significant. [1]

I ran into a data leakage problem where the feature "account_status_updated_at" was only populated after a customer had churned, leading to the label being leaked. This issue was addressed by removing the feature and implementing a time-based split, resulting in a lower AUC of 0.89. [1]
